title: Assistente De Planejamento De Demanda E Controle Da Produção
description:
Sobre Barentz

A Barentz é uma distribuidora líder global de ingredientes de alto desempenho para ciências biológicas. A empresa oferece ingredientes e especialidades dos principais fabricantes em todo o mundo, bem como suporte técnico de valor agregado, incluindo pré-mistura, mistura, formulação de ingredientes e testes de ingredientes em seus centros de formulação e laboratórios de aplicações de última geração na região EMEA, Américas e Ásia-Pacífico.

Fundada em 1953, a Barentz opera em mais de 70 países, com forte presença na Europa e na América do Norte e uma rede em rápido crescimento na América Latina e na Ásia-Pacífico. Com um volume de negócios de 2,5 mil milhões de euros, a empresa emprega mais de 2.500 pessoas em todo o mundo e serve mais de 25.000 clientes. Para mais informações visite nosso site:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Assistente de Planejamento de Demanda e Planejamento e Controle da Produção (PCP) para apoiar as rotinas de benefícios, controle de ponto, medicina do trabalho e processos admissionais.

Apoiar as rotinas das áreas de Planejamento de Demanda e Planejamento e Controle da Produção (PCP), contribuindo para a coleta, organização, atualização e controle de informações relacionadas a vendas, estoque, forecast, disponibilidade de produtos, planejamento de amostras, industrialização em terceiros e indicadores operacionais.

O cargo tem como foco dar suporte às análises e aos processos de planejamento, garantindo a confiabilidade dos dados, o cumprimento das rotinas estabelecidas e a integração das informações entre as áreas Comercial, Compras, Supply Chain, Operações, Logística, Qualidade, Produção Terceirizada e demais áreas envolvidas, assegurando o adequado planejamento e acompanhamento das operações produtivas e do abastecimento.

Desafios do Cargo

  • Apoiar a organização de dados de vendas, estoque e demanda com atenção aos detalhes e confiabilidade;

  • Apoiar o planejamento e controle das produções realizadas em terceiros, acompanhando embarques, recebimentos e prazos de fabricação;
  • Garantir o controle e acompanhamento do fluxo de envio e retorno de materiais destinados à industrialização em terceiros;
  • Apoiar o planejamento e acompanhamento das amostras, garantindo disponibilidade, cumprimento de prazos e atendimento às demandas comerciais e técnicas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Apoiar a coleta, consolidação, atualização e conferência de dados de vendas, demanda, estoque, pedidos, disponibilidade de produtos e abastecimento.
  • Atualizar planilhas, relatórios, dashboards, cadastros e controles operacionais em sistemas ERP, ferramentas de BI e plataformas internas.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de planejamento e estoque, como cobertura, giro, ruptura, acuracidade, excesso, obsolescência, produtos críticos e itens de baixo giro.
  • Apoiar a preparação de informações para reuniões de forecast, S&OP, planejamento de demanda e alinhamentos internos.
  • Auxiliar no acompanhamento de solicitações de compra, requisições, ordens de produção, cronogramas e prazos de abastecimento.
  • Apoiar o planejamento e o controle das produções realizadas por parceiros terceirizados, incluindo envio de matérias-primas, acompanhamento da fabricação, recebimento e atualização dos saldos.
  • Monitorar atrasos, desvios, inconsistências e riscos de abastecimento, reportando as ocorrências às áreas responsáveis.
  • Apoiar o planejamento e o controle de amostras, garantindo disponibilidade de materiais e atendimento aos prazos acordados.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior cursando ou completo em Administração, Logística, Engenharia de Produção, Comércio Exterior, Economia, Gestão Comercial, Gestão de Supply Chain ou áreas correlatas.
  • Desejáveis cursos complementares em Excel, Power BI, Planejamento, Supply Chain, Análise de Dados ou áreas relacionadas.

Diferenciais

  • Desejável experiência anterior em rotinas administrativas, planejamento, controle de estoque, logística, supply chain, compras, suporte comercial ou áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável vivência com atualização de planilhas, relatórios, controles operacionais, conferência de dados, sistemas ERP ou apoio a processos de demanda e abastecimento.

title: Analista De Catálogo De Peças Automotivas Pleno | Marketplace | E-Commerce | Cadastro
description:
Sobre a AutoZone

A AutoZone é uma empresa americana e multinacional, listada na Bolsa de Valores de Nova York, reconhecida como a maior rede varejista de autopeças e acessórios automotivos do mundo. Atualmente, possui mais de 7.000 lojas distribuídas pelos Estados Unidos, Porto Rico, México e Brasil, com o apoio de mais de 100.000 AutoZoners em quatro continentes.

No Brasil, a companhia mantém um ritmo acelerado de crescimento, com mais de 158 lojas em sete estados — São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná e Goiás — além de um escritório corporativo em São Paulo, localizado na Vila Leopoldina. Em 2025, foi inaugurado o Centro de Distribuição próprio em Paulínia/SP, fortalecendo a estrutura logística e sustentando a estratégia de expansão no país.

A AutoZone tem como princípios a mentalidade de cliente em primeiro lugar e o compromisso de ir além. Fazer parte da empresa significa integrar uma equipe que valoriza dedicação, trabalho em equipe e desenvolvimento profissional, oferecendo suporte e ferramentas para o crescimento e construção de carreira dos AutoZoners.

Descrição do Cargo

Registrar e manter atualizado, o cadastro dos dados de produtos de menor complexidade oferecidos nas lojas, inserindo os itens relacionados aos sistemas automotivos, por veículo, ano e tipo, complementando com dados dos fornecedores, representantes, entre outros, visando a segurança e qualidade das informações processadas para utilização pelas lojas na venda de produtos.

Responsabilidades

  • Zelar pela integridade dos dados cadastrados, auditando sua procedência por meio de pesquisas na Internet e informações das áreas internas, conforme padrões de segurança definidos pela Matriz.
  • Receber dos fornecedores as aplicações dos produtos ou realizar pesquisas para cada novo produto/SKU, consultando catálogos dos fornecedores, vídeos na internet e mecânicos, com o objetivo de preparar o catálogo da AutoZone.
  • Informar as áreas internas sobre eventuais divergências nos dados e solicitar as correções necessárias.
  • Auxiliar na geração e atualização do catálogo eletrônico de peças hard parts, incluindo aplicações por modelo de veículo, características e imagens dos produtos.
  • Enviar o catálogo atualizado para a equipe do México para inserção no sistema.
  • Receber e analisar informações enviadas pelas lojas, via sistema, para identificar necessidades de inclusão ou atualização de produtos a serem disponibilizados no portfólio.

Qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Conhecimento no pacote office.
  • Diferencial: inglês.
  • Diferencial: Curso Técnico de Mecânica e/ou Elétrica.

Informações Adicionais

  • Tipo de contrato: CLT.
  • Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido, com atuação na região da Vila Leopoldina.
  • Benefícios oferecidos: assistência médica, assistência odontológica, seguro de vida, vale-refeição, convênio com academias, programa de apoio ao AutoZoner e 20% de desconto em produtos nas lojas AutoZone.

Valorizamos a diversidade e promovemos ambientes inclusivos. Todas as pessoas, independentemente de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, idade ou deficiência, são bem-vindas para se candidatar.

Que tal fazer parte dessa jornada?

Venha crescer com a AutoZone e impulsionar o futuro da sua carreira!

title: Office Management Manager-Brazil
description:
Position Overview

As a comprehensive workplace manager, you will be responsible for establishing the administrative system for large‐scale integrated workplaces, leading team management, and conducting in‐depth alignment with corporate headquarters administration.

Application Scope

This role applies to large‐scale integrated workplaces (headcount ≥ 50) or regional administrative lead positions. Incumbents are expected to undertake team management, budget decision‐making and strategic planning responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities

1.1 Workplace Operation Strategy & Management

1)Formulate regional workplace operation strategies, drive continuous improvement of office environment and employee experience upgrade.

2)Build regional 5S management system and develop reusable management standards.

3)Plan annual activity calendar and oversee delivery of regional cultural events.

4)Establish reception service standards and coordinate cross‐regional high‐profile receptions.

5)Take overall charge of regional EHS compliance management and develop emergency response frameworks.

1.2 Expense & Budget Oversight

1)Lead preparation and review of regional administrative budgets, and take accountability for regional budget outcomes.

2)Approve regional expense disbursements, monitor compliance risks and identify cost‐saving & efficiency‐improvement opportunities.

3)Collaborate with headquarters to deliver regional cost optimization and maintain healthy overall expense performance.

4)Oversee payments to regional vendors, control payment schedules and leverage payment terms to optimize cash flow.

1.3 Asset Management Oversight

1)Establish regional asset management policy framework to guarantee consistency between asset records and physical inventory.

2)Approve major vehicle procurement and disposal proposals, and optimize allocation of regional vehicle resources.

3)Align with headquarters asset policies, and supervise regional asset inventory and disposal activities.

1.4 Vendor Management

1)Participate in headquarters‐level vendor framework negotiations to optimize regional supply chain.

2)Manage relationships with key regional vendors and drive continuous service improvement.

3)Develop regional vendor tier‐based management system to iteratively optimize supply‐chain structure.

4)Review and approve proposals for regional vendor onboarding and offboarding.

1.5 Regional Workplace Construction & Standardization

1)Develop strategies for launching new country‐level workplaces, align with headquarters resources to ensure standardized implementation.

2)Contribute to headquarters administrative standard formulation, and supervise regional training and compliance execution.

3)Facilitate experience sharing and methodology accumulation across regional workplaces.

1.6 Visa & Expat Assignment Support

1)Build regional support framework for expatriate employees, coordinate resources to guarantee smooth on‐landing for assignees.

2)Collaborate with headquarters Administration and HR teams to continuously enhance regional expatriate support solutions.

1.7 Onboarding & Offboarding Administrative Support

1)Establish standardized SOPs for regional employee onboarding and offboarding administrative support to deliver seamless employee experience and efficient handover.

1.8 Digital‐enabled Administrative Service

1)Lead promotion and operation of regional administrative service platforms to advance digitalization of local administrative services.

2)Consolidate regional system requirements and partner with headquarters Administration to iterate platform functionalities.

1.9 Communication & IT Infrastructure Support

1)Develop regional communication and IT infrastructure operation strategies to ensure stable connectivity of office networks and communication facilities.

2)Participate in formulation and optimization of regional IT support solutions.

1.10 Team Management

3)Directly manage administrative teams including Supervisors and Specialists, covering recruitment & selection, performance management and talent development.

4)Drive cross‐department collaboration within the region, represent the administrative function in business decision‐making and major project governance.

5)Maintain close alignment with headquarters Administration, and contribute to headquarters administrative decision‐making and system building.

6)Set up regional administrative talent pipeline development mechanisms.

Education & Professional Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or above, major in Administration Management, Business Administration, Human Resources or related disciplines is preferred.
  • 5‐8 years or above working experience in administration, operation or relevant fields, with minimum 2 years of people‐management experience.
  • Prior experience in multinational enterprises or cross‐cultural management is a plus.

Core Competencies

  • Strategic Thinking: Systematic mindset, capable of contributing to headquarters standard‐setting and providing professional judgment for regional matters.
  • Business Acumen: Take ownership of regional administrative budget performance; proactively identify cost‐reduction and efficiency‐gain opportunities.
  • Organizational Influence: Direct‐line team management capability, with proven track record in talent selection, development and performance management.
  • Cross‐cultural Communication: Deliver effective communication across cultures and hierarchy levels, and manage complex stakeholder relationships.
  • Risk Anticipation: Foresee potential risks, formulate contingency plans and resolve regional issues in a systematic manner.

Language & Qualifications

  • Fluent in English and local language for high‐level business communication and negotiation.
  • Possess a valid local driving license.

Next steps:

As part of our application process, certain positions at our company require a pre-employment screening to ensure the reliability and integrity of our employees. This screening is a standard procedure and may include components such as a Criminal Background Check from your current or previous country of residence over the past five years. Additionally, the process may involve an integrity questionnaire, verification of identification, diplomas, work experience, and consultation of the central insolvency register.

We appreciate your understanding and cooperation in this important matter, as it helps us maintain the high standards expected by our team.

A Kavak iniciou a revolução no mercado automotivo em 2016, criando uma plataforma baseada no uso de dados e tecnologia que compra, recondiciona e vende carros usados pela internet ou nas dependências da empresa (hubs), com todas as garantias de segurança e confiabilidade, além das melhores opções de financiamento. title: Video Editor
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle: from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.

Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.

The Role

We are seeking a talented Video Editor to create high-performing video content for paid social advertising campaigns. You will edit engaging, conversion-focused video ads for Meta, TikTok, and Instagram Reels while working closely with our creative strategists and design team. This role requires fast turnaround capabilities, a keen understanding of performance creative principles, and the ability to manage multiple client projects simultaneously in a fully remote environment.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently high video output with exceptional quality and attention to detail
  • Strong creative performance metrics (CTR, watch time, engagement) across your video portfolio
  • Seamless collaboration with creative strategists, designers, and media buyers to iterate and optimize
  • Efficient project management and timely delivery across multiple concurrent client accounts

Responsibilities

  • Edit high-performing video ads for paid social campaigns across Meta, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts
  • Execute on creative briefs and storyboards developed by creative strategists
  • Add motion graphics, text overlays, captions, and effects to enhance video storytelling and performance
  • Work with raw UGC footage and branded content to create attention-grabbing, under-15-second video ads
  • Iterate quickly on video concepts based on performance data and feedback from media buyers
  • Maintain brand consistency across multiple client accounts while adapting to different brand voices
  • Organize and manage video assets, project files, and creative libraries across all client accounts
  • Stay current on platform trends, best practices, and format specifications for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and Meta
  • Collaborate with creative strategists on video concepts and provide input on creative direction
  • Conduct research on competitor ads and trending content to inform video creative approaches
  • Pull and optimize stills from videos for ad thumbnails and static creative variations
  • Participate in weekly design team meetings and collaborate with designers and fellow video editors

Requirements

  • 2-4 years of video editing experience, preferably in performance marketing or advertising
  • Expert proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe After Effects
  • Motion graphics and animation capabilities
  • Portfolio demonstrating social-first video work for paid advertising (Meta, TikTok, Instagram Reels)
  • Strong understanding of performance creative principles and direct response video best practices
  • Proven ability to work in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines and high volume output
  • Experience editing UGC (User Generated Content) and creator-style content
  • Excellent attention to detail with strong quality control standards
  • Fluent English communication skills for client collaboration and team coordination
  • DTC or ecommerce experience working with product-focused brands
  • Comfortable working remotely with distributed teams across multiple time zones

Nice to Have

  • Experience with CapCut or other mobile-first editing tools
  • Sound design and audio mixing skills
  • Understanding of TikTok and Instagram Reels trends and viral content strategies
  • Experience with color grading and advanced post-production techniques
  • Basic design skills in Figma or Adobe Creative Suite
  • Agency experience managing multiple concurrent client projects

Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off: Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience

title: Financial Assistant
description:
Finance Compliance Specialist

Location: Cidade Monções, São Paulo, Brazil

Work Arrangement: Five days onsite

Travel Requirement: No regular travel required

Work Schedule: Subject to local labor laws and regulations;
the role requires frequent collaboration across Brazil–China time zones

Overtime Requirement: Subject to local labor laws and regulations

Role Overview

We are looking for a Finance Compliance Specialist based in São Paulo, Brazil. This role will support financial compliance, accounting, tax reporting, audit coordination, regulatory data reporting, and account reconciliation activities across Brazil, Mexico, the United States, and other key Latin American markets.

The ideal candidate will have 3–8 years of professional experience in finance, accounting, audit, tax, or compliance. The candidate must be fluent in both Portuguese and English and comfortable working closely with stakeholders in Brazil, mainland China, and Hong Kong across different time zones.

Experience as an auditor, or substantial experience coordinating with internal or external auditors, is required. Knowledge of Brazilian taxation, including differences in tax requirements across Brazilian states, will be considered a strong advantage.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor and support compliance with financial regulations, tax laws, statutory requirements, and reporting obligations across Brazil, the United States, Mexico, and other key Latin American jurisdictions.
  • Participate in corporate compliance activities, including external regulatory filings, statutory data submissions, financial data reporting, and other compliance-related declarations.
  • Prepare, review, and coordinate the filing of statutory financial statements, tax returns, regulatory reports, and other required submissions in accordance with applicable local laws.
  • Support internal and external audits by preparing documentation, responding to audit inquiries, providing explanations, and coordinating with relevant internal stakeholders.
  • Liaise with external auditors, tax advisers, tax authorities, legal counsel, and other external service providers regarding audits, compliance matters, and regulatory inquiries.
  • Monitor changes in financial, accounting, tax, and compliance regulations and assess their potential impact on company operations.
  • Collaborate with regional and global finance teams to implement and improve finance compliance policies, internal controls, and operating procedures.
  • Identify financial and compliance risks and recommend corrective or preventive actions.
  • Maintain accurate and complete records of compliance activities, regulatory submissions, audit documentation, and supporting materials.
  • Conduct detailed reconciliations of key accounts, investigate discrepancies, and ensure issues are resolved in a timely manner.
  • Provide support for tax-related matters, where required, including research and coordination regarding Brazilian federal, state, and municipal tax requirements.
  • Work closely with local Portuguese-speaking stakeholders and communicate in English with teams and stakeholders in mainland China and Hong Kong.
  • Participate in meetings and complete business-critical tasks across Brazil–China time zones when necessary.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or above in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Taxation, or a related field.
  • 3–8 years of relevant professional experience in financial compliance, accounting, audit, tax, or a related finance function.
  • Previous professional experience as an auditor, or hands-on experience coordinating internal or external audit processes.
  • Practical experience participating in corporate compliance activities, such as regulatory reporting, external data submissions, statutory filings, or similar compliance work.
  • Experience or exposure to multi-country finance operations, preferably involving Brazil, Latin America, the United States, mainland China, or Hong Kong.
  • Familiarity with Brazilian accounting, tax, and regulatory requirements.
  • Knowledge of local GAAP and/or IFRS applicable to Latin American jurisdictions.
  • Professional fluency in spoken and written Portuguese, as the role will work directly with local Brazilian stakeholders.
  • Professional fluency in spoken and written English, as the role will communicate with stakeholders in mainland China and Hong Kong.
  • Willingness and ability to work five days onsite in Cidade Monções, São Paulo.
  • Willingness and ability to accommodate frequent cross-time-zone collaboration between Brazil and China.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and deliver accurate work in a fast-paced and cross-cultural environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience handling or supporting tax-related work in Brazil.
  • Understanding of Brazilian federal, state, and municipal tax systems, including differences in tax regulations and requirements across Brazilian states.
  • CPA, CRC, or an equivalent professional accounting or audit certification.
  • Experience working for an audit firm or in an internal audit, finance compliance, or controllership function.
  • Experience working with companies operating across both Latin America and Asia.
  • Familiarity with compliance, accounting, and ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, or similar platforms.
  • Professional proficiency in Spanish.

description:
Que desafio temos para você?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Bombeiro(a) para atuar no time de Saúde e Segurança do Trabalho.

Quais as responsabilidades?

Atuar nas emergências conforme os procedimentos operacionais padrão de cada cenário emergencial;

Organizar, capacitar e coordenar as brigadas industriais e agrícolas;

Conduzir veículosde emergência (ambulância e caminhão pipa);

Programar e executar teste, inspeção, ensaio, limpeza, substituição e/ou reposição de equipamentos, veículos, sistemas de proteção de combate a incêndio e de atendimento as emergências;

Treinar os brigadistas em combate a incêndio, vazamentos de produtos químicos, primeiros socorros e outros;

Registrar as intervenções, elaborar relatórios de simulados, intercorrências e atas de turno;

Organizar, conduzir e ou coordenar simulado de emergências conforme os cenários de riscos mapeados.

Quais os requisitos?

Curso de bombeiro profissional civil (vigente);

CNH C ou D;

Curso de transporte de veículos de emergência (vigente);

Pacote Office;

Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos;

Residir em Olímpia, Severínia, Cajobi ou Baguaçu/SP.

Qual localidade?

Olímpia - SP

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. title: Cloud Coe Solution Architect Gcp
description:
Cloud CoE Solution Architect GCP - Sao Paulo-Guararema

Mars is a $50B+ global powerhouse driving the next generation of digital transformation. We are a family-owned business operating in 80+ countries with over 150,000 Associates. Guided by our Five Principles—Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency, and Freedom—we are currently embarking on a massive Digital Core program to modernize our global technology landscape and build the future of our enterprise cloud capabilities.

When you join Mars, you join a purpose-driven company where we're striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.

The Opportunity

As a Cloud Center of Excellence (CCoE) Solution Architect , you will play a critical role in driving the design, architecture, and delivery of cloud solutions for the entire organization. You will collaborate with a global team of architects to develop and implement Mars' platforms and cloud-based systems that power our operations every day.

Working within the CCoE Client Solutions team, you will act as a bridge between cloud architects, enterprise architecture, security, and business stakeholders. Your mission will be to develop services, establish landing zones, and design secure, scalable architectures for high-impact, unique digital projects.

Key Responsibilities

In this role, you will balance technical excellence with collaborative enablement. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

  • Architectural Design & Blueprinting: Assess business demands and technical requirements to create robust, highly available, and fault-tolerant Low-Level Designs (LLDs).
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Lead the implementation of cloud solutions utilizing modern IaC practices (Git, Terraform) to automate and scale deployments.
  • Scalability & Performance: Design and architect systems that support elasticity, ensuring cost-optimizations and peak performance.
  • Security & Compliance: Ensure all solutions align strictly with the Mars Cloud Adoption Framework, Security Principles, and Well-Architected Frameworks.
  • Collaboration & Leadership: Act as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) in the CCoE for customer LLD/Deployment Projects, guiding cross-functional design discussions and contributing to the service catalog's evolution.
  • Cloud Advocacy: Act as a Cloud Ambassador across Mars, promoting cloud adoption, sharing best practices, and mentoring other technical teams.

What We Are Looking For

Core Technical Skills & Experience (Must-Haves):

  • Proven GCP Expertise: Hands-on experience architecting and deploying enterprise-grade solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and its primary services.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Strong experience deploying cloud infrastructure via Terraform and managing workflows with Git.
  • Solution Design & Integration: Deep proficiency in application architecture, system integration, data modeling, and designing for high availability/disaster recovery.
  • Software Engineering Foundation: In-depth knowledge of modern software development principles, methodologies, and enterprise architectures.
  • Security Mindset: Practical understanding of cloud security principles, identity and access management (IAM), data protection, and compliance standards.

Leadership & Soft Skills:

  • Stakeholder Management: Experience translating complex technical concepts into clear business value for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Problem-Solving: Exceptional analytical and structured problem-solving skills with a track record of driving clarity in ambiguous environments.
  • Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional, multicultural, and global teams.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Experience with other major cloud platforms (such as Microsoft Azure or AWS).
  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (e.G., TOGAF).
  • Professional GCP certifications (e.G., Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Cloud Security Engineer).

What to Expect in This Role

  • Balancing Speed and Governance: The Cloud CoE is an enabler, not a bottleneck. Your success means building robust landing zones that protect our enterprise systems while empowering developers to innovate at pace.
  • Complex Multi-Stakeholder Collaboration: You will regularly coordinate between software developers, security officers, and business leaders. Clear, jargon-free communication is your primary tool for aligning vision.

What Can You Expect from Mars?

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with diverse, talented, and highly supportive Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
  • Continuous Learning: Access to best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including our in-house Mars University and specialized cloud certification pathways.
  • Competitive Compensation: An industry-competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package, including a performance-based company bonus.
  • Global Impact: The opportunity to work on projects that directly influence a global scale, touching millions of lives every day.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Mars is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process because of a disability, it is available upon request. The company is pleased to provide such assistance, and no applicant will be penalized as a result of such a request.

title: Técnico De Automação
description:
Sobre a vaga

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS);
painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR);
resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Principais atividades:

  • Analisar, padronizar e customizar os programas dos CLPs (Controlador Lógico Programável), manter backups atualizados destes e dos supervisórios, para manutenção da segurança de operação das máquinas e manutenção do sistema;
  • Analisar, padronizar e customizar interfaces de operação, supervisórios e/ou IHMs (interface homem máquina), a fim de facilitar a operação e melhorar a qualidade das informações dos processos;
  • Fazer manutenção, calibrar e controlar os instrumentos das instalações, visando melhoria na qualidade do produto, redução no custo de produção e confiabilidade do processo produtivo;
  • Executar serviços de manutenção eletromecânica, eletroeletrônica, eletropneumática, eletrotécnica e instrumentação industrial, para o funcionamento dos equipamentos e reparar ou substituir partes e peças dos equipamentos elétricos;
  • Monitorar as atividades de manutenção preventivas, preditivas e ou corretivas programadas, acompanhando a mão de obra contratada durante a execução das atividades, bem como, disponibilizando os recursos necessários para a realização da atividade;
  • Especificar e inspecionar equipamentos para automação das máquinas, e implementar melhorias para maior confiabilidade do processo produtivo e aumento da produtividade;
  • Monitorar a tecnologia de automação disponível do mercado para adaptação ao processo produtivo e implementar pequenos projetos de automação.

Requisitos:

  • Curso Técnico completo em automação, eletromecânica e/ou eletrônica;
  • NR 10 básico e NR 10 SEP;
  • Conhecimento emmanutenção de máquinas e equipamentos industriais;

By integrating Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) and Artificial Intelligence (AI), Gene Solutions offers a comprehensive portfolio of advanced genetic solutions that empower reproductive health, enable multi-cancer early detection, and support precision oncology.

Our Mission

As Gene Solutions expands globally, our mission remains clear: Bring World-class Genomics Closer to All.

We are committed to making genetic testing more accessible, affordable, and clinically impactful-empowering physicians and patients worldwide through innovation, collaboration, and cutting-edge science.

If you're passionate about advancing healthcare, driving innovation, and making a meaningful impact through medical AI, we invite you to join us in shaping the future of medicine.

What are the Objectives of this Role?

  • Support the company's image of expertise and trustworthiness and help achieve superior brand equity through effective medical communication and medical project management

What are the Responsibilities of this Role?

  • Cascades Test results and lead Pre & Post test Counselling. Can be consulted in CORE inputs.
  • Lead clinical trial activities in Brazil.
  • Advises the Business Development Director on the necessary health regulatory requirements & updates. Evaluate medical, regulatory, & compliance risks of company policies and support implementation of compliance.
  • Medical Management includes, but is not limited to, those mentioned above plus supporting Advisory Board Meetings, doing speakership programs, reviewing of marketing/ selling materials to ensure compliance with local guidelines, addressing test queries, product knowledge training, customer engagement, patient support programs like pre & post test counselling, etc.
  • Initiate, oversee, support and follow-up medical projects to support Sales & Marketing Initiatives
  • Provide communication, reports or presentations per task or per call as may be reasonably necessary to fulfill obligations.
  • Ensure the above is completed on time with quality
  • Acts as Speaker, Moderator, Reactor or Advocate among colleagues and necessary stakeholders in lectures & seminars

We would love to hear from You if You have:

Similar experiences typically include:

  • Medical Doctor preferably in Oncology or Genetics & related field
  • Preferably Pharmaceutical, Medical Device or Laboratory experience
  • Desired skills: knowledge in the Therapeutic Area, Regulatory Requirements, Processes, Evidence-based Medicine
  • Outstanding communication and critical thinking skills
  • Creative thinking and able to have a good understanding of the market and its latest
  • trends

title: Product Designer Sênior (Loyalty)
description:
SOBRE NÓS

Dá para (r)evolucionar o agro no digital? Nós acreditamos que sim!

Olá, nós somos a Orbia, uma empresa de tecnologia brasileira dedicada à transformação digital do agronegócio. Com orgulho, somos a maior plataforma digital integrada do setor na América Latina, conectando mais de 284 mil usuários no Brasil.

Com pioneirismo no nosso DNA, reunimos soluções organizadas em três pilares principais:

Orbia Compras: sua rede de compras no agro | Um marketplace robusto para compras online de insumos agrícolas, oferecendo cobertura nacional por meio de mais de 300 distribuidores, revendas e indústrias parceiras.

Orbia Clube: sua rede de vantagens e benefícios no agro | O maior programa de pontos, fidelidade e coalizão do agro no Brasil, com mais de 10 empresas parceiras e um catálogo com mais de 25 mil produtos e serviços.

Orbia Pag: sua rede de soluções financeiras no agro | Um hub financeiro que oferece crédito de forma ágil e digital para produtores rurais adquirirem insumos com segurança.

Tudo isso de forma 100% digital, segura e prática, sem que nossos clientes precisem sair de casa ou da fazenda.

Desde o nosso início, em 2019, contamos com bases sólidas e acionistas de renome no setor, como Bayer, Bravium, Yara Fertilizantes e Itaú BBA. Todos acreditam em nosso potencial de crescimento, em dois dos maiores mercados globais: tecnologia e agronegócio.

Os nossos #Orbians , como chamamos carinhosamente o nosso time de talentos, são pessoas diversas, únicas e motivadas a enfrentar grandes desafios. Aqui, você é o protagonista da sua história! Juntos, estamos construindo o futuro da Orbia e do agronegócio.

NOSSOS VALORES

Empreendedorismo

Diversidade

Confiabilidade

Resultado

title: Digital Designer (Marketing)
description:
Overview

Wunderdogs is an independent creative agency with a growing (20+) distributed team across the U.S., Canada and Europe. We provide beginning-to-end strategy, design and production services to forward-thinking brands in the technology space, from startups to established companies.

We're looking for a Digital Designer (Marketing) to join our team and work primarily with our retainer clients. Unlike project-based work, you'll develop deep, ongoing relationships with a portfolio of clients, becoming an extension of their marketing teams and developing an intimate understanding of their brands, audiences, and business goals.

You'll report to both the Design Team Lead and Head of Creative and Strategy, working across a wide range of marketing assets. This role requires a designer who thrives on variety, works quickly without sacrificing quality, and has a deep understanding of marketing asset creation across digital channels.

Key Responsibilities
Marketing Asset Creation

  • Designing social media content across platforms (LinkedIn, Instagram, Twitter/X, Facebook), including static posts, carousels, and stories
  • Creating webinar and event graphics, including promotional banners, registration pages, presentation templates, and recap assets
  • Developing one-pagers, sell sheets, and product/feature overviews
  • Designing email headers, newsletter templates, and digital campaign assets
  • Creating infographics, data visualizations, and report layouts
  • Designing blog graphics, featured images, and content marketing visuals
  • Producing landing page designs and website banners
  • Creating presentation decks for sales, investors, and internal use
  • Designing trade show and event collateral (booth graphics, handouts, signage)
  • Adapting and resizing assets for multiple formats and platforms

Brand Stewardship

  • Maintaining brand consistency across all touchpoints for assigned clients
  • Building and maintaining template libraries and asset repositories
  • Contributing to design system development and documentation
  • Evolving client brands within established guidelines while keeping them fresh

Collaboration & Process

  • Working under the supervision of the Design Team Lead while maintaining direct communication with leadership
  • Collaborating closely with Account Managers to understand client priorities and deadlines
  • Managing multiple client requests simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail
  • Participating in client calls and incorporating feedback quickly
  • Working efficiently within retainer hour allocations

Key KPIs

  • Operational Efficiency: Deviation from estimates < 10%
  • Client Satisfaction (CSAT): Average score 4.7+
  • Internal Quality Score: Average score 4.7+
  • Client Creative Feedback: Average score 4.7+
  • Turnaround Time: Meeting SLAs for retainer deliverables

Requirements

  • 3-5+ years of experience in marketing design, preferably at an agency or in-house marketing team
  • Deep experience with marketing asset types: social media graphics, webinar materials, one-pagers, email templates, presentations, infographics
  • Strong understanding of social media platforms and their design requirements/best practices
  • Expert proficiency in Figma (primary tool)
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign)
  • Proficiency with AI tools
  • Experience with motion/animation tools a plus (After Effects, Lottie)
  • Ability to work quickly and efficiently without sacrificing quality
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to maintain brand consistency
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple client accounts
  • Comfortable with remote collaboration via Slack, video calls, and project management tools
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating range across marketing asset types

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with B2B technology brands
  • Basic motion design / animation skills
  • Experience with HubSpot, Marketo, or other marketing automation platforms
  • Understanding of conversion-focused design principles
  • Experience building and maintaining design systems

The Perks

  • Diverse team (team members are based in US, UK, Europe, Canada, LATAM)
  • Working with interesting clients in the technology space
  • Fully remote
  • A highly cooperative team that encourages professional growth and self-development
  • Salary is commensurate with experience and market-rate at the candidate's location

To be considered, apply with your cover letter, CV, and portfolio.

title: Senior Geotechnical Engineer
description:
Are you looking to grow professionally in a company where you can become a partner? Our core values are the Client, the Individual and Professional Development. If this resonates with you, keep reading!

ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

We are looking for a Senior Geotechnical Engineer to join our Infrastructure Area in our offices in Spain (Madrid or Bilbao).

At IDOM, we offer you the opportunity to develop your professional career by actively participating in national and international projects that will challenge you to improve every day, in a collaborative, team-oriented environment. You will join a multidisciplinary group where you will play a key role in project development. You will gain a broad perspective on different businesses and technologies in a flexible and trusting work environment.

If you join IDOM, you will find:

  • Flexible working hours
  • Remote working one day or two afternoons per week
  • Flexible benefits package (meal card, health insurance, public transport card, childcare, etc.)
  • Life and accident insurance
  • Work-life balance
  • A commitment to long-term professional development
  • Opportunity for everyone to become a company owner
  • A multicultural and multidisciplinary environment
  • A strong culture of delegation, beyond what is customary
  • Mutual commitment
  • Interpersonal relationships that foster unity

ABOUT YOU

Do not hesitate to apply if...

  • You hold a degree in Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Mining Engineering or an equivalent qualification.
  • You have 8-12 years of experience in geotechnical and foundation engineering projects. Experience in foundation geotechnics, the design of shallow and deep foundations, the design of retaining solutions (diaphragm walls, anchors), and road geotechnics (stability analysis and support design for embankments and slopes in both soil and rock) will be highly valued.
  • You are proficient in software such as Plaxis, RS2, Rido, Slide, Swedge and RocPlane.
  • You have strong teamwork skills and technical rigour.
  • You are autonomous and have an innovative mindset.
  • You have a good command of English.
  • Above all, you are eager to develop your career in an international company such as IDOM.

ABOUT US

IDOM is an Association of Professionals whose activity focuses on delivering Engineering, Architecture and Consulting projects that contribute to a more sustainable world. At IDOM, we are connected through our work and through ownership of the Firm, and we cooperate to achieve our highest professional and personal development while providing the best service to the Client.

For this reason, IDOM's fundamental asset is the talent and experience of its people. Highly qualified professionals with strong human values, deeply united and working within a framework that respects their professional identity and freedom, with a strong ambition for progress, development, service and innovation.

Since our foundation in 1957, we have grown continuously and are now a multidisciplinary, integrated international organisation, present in 130 countries, where more than 4,300 people carry out their professional work.

Are you ready to take the next step?

If you join our TEAM, you will be able to develop your career at the highest level in an environment of deep trust and professional respect.

If you share our philosophy and would like to be part of our company, send us your CV.

We would love to meet you!

title: Commercial Financial Bp
description:
At Terumo Blood and Cell Technologies, our 8,000+ global associates are proud to come to work each day, knowing that what we do impacts the lives of patients around the world.

We make medical devices and related products that are used to collect, separate, manufacture and process various components of blood and cells. With our innovative technologies and service offerings, we touch a patient's life every second of every day and are committed to continuing to increase the number of patients we serve.

With some of the best and brightest minds in the industry, an unmatched global footprint, comprehensive benefits and a distinct culture, Terumo Blood and Cell Technologies is a great place to work, grow and be part of a team that is focused on making a difference. Consider joining our team and unlock your potential.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are looking for a Commercial Finance Business Partner LATAM to support the commercial organization across the region and act as a key financial partner in business growth and decision-making.

This is a regional role with exposure to multiple LATAM markets, working closely with Sales, Finance, Marketing, Operations and other business stakeholders. The position will play a critical role in connecting financial strategy with commercial objectives, providing insights that support profitable and sustainable growth.

The ideal candidate will combine strong financial expertise with a genuine business mindset, the ability to challenge commercial decisions constructively, and the agility to operate in a dynamic, multicultural environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Partner with LATAM commercial leadership to analyze business performance and identify opportunities to improve sales, profitability and operating results.
  • Prepare and evaluate business cases for customer transactions, new business opportunities and strategic initiatives, providing financial recommendations to support decision-making.
  • Analyze sales, margins, profitability, pricing and operating expenses, identifying risks and opportunities and recommending proactive actions.
  • Lead and coordinate budgeting, forecasting and strategic planning processes across LATAM, including variance analysis and management reporting.
  • Develop financial models and projections for new business opportunities, customer solutions, investments and strategic projects.
  • Support the commercial organization in evaluating customer deals, pricing strategies and profitability, challenging assumptions when necessary to ensure sustainable growth.
  • Prepare weekly sales forecasts and monthly reports and dashboards to provide clear visibility into LATAM commercial performance.
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Operations and Finance teams across different LATAM countries, acting as a bridge between regional and global finance organizations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve internal processes, pricing competitiveness and financial efficiency across the region.
  • Support Sales and commercial teams with financial tools, analysis and training to strengthen business decision-making.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Education

- University degree in Economics, Finance, Business Administration or a related field. Accounting background is a plus.

Experience

  • 7+ years of relevant professional experience, ideally with 5–8 years in Commercial Finance, FP&A or Business Partnering roles.
  • Experience working with commercial teams in a regional or multinational environment.
  • Strong understanding of pricing, profitability, forecasting and financial modeling.
  • Experience working across LATAM or other emerging markets is highly valued.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced financial modeling and analytical capabilities.
  • Strong knowledge of budgeting, forecasting and P&L analysis.
  • Experience with pricing and profitability analysis.
  • Ability to translate financial and market data into actionable business recommendations.
  • Advanced Excel skills and experience with reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI.
  • Experience with ERP and financial systems, preferably SAP.

Business & Leadership Skills

  • Strong commercial mindset and understanding of business growth drivers.
  • Ability to influence decisions and challenge commercial strategies through data and financial insights.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to explain financial concepts to non-financial stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders across different countries and cultures.

Languages

  • Advanced English is required.
  • Spanish and/or Portuguese are highly valued for regional collaboration.

Location & Travel

The position will be based in one of Terumo Blood and Cell Technologies' LATAM locations, with a regional scope covering key markets across Latin America. Availability to travel within the region as required.

WHY JOIN TERUMO BLOOD AND CELL TECHNOLOGIES?

Terumo Blood and Cell Technologies is part of Terumo Group, founded in 1921 and headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

In 2024, Terumo Blood and Cell Technologies reached $1.5 billion in revenue.

We employ nearly 8,000 associates globally, with global headquarters in Lakewood, CO, U.S., and regional headquarters in Brussels, Buenos Aires, Singapore and Tokyo.

We manufacture devices, disposable sets and solutions at our facilities in Belgium, India, Japan, Northern Ireland, the U.S. and Vietnam. Our global presence enables us to serve customers in more than 130 countries.

Our core values help set our direction, guide our actions and keep us true to our corporate mission of contributing to society through healthcare.

  • Respect – Appreciative of others
  • Integrity – Guided by our mission
  • Care – Empathetic to patients
  • Quality – Committed to excellence
  • Creativity – Striving for innovation

title: Senior Warehouse Supervisor - Guarulhos
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!

About the job

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Warehouse Supervisor to oversee daily logistics operations within a business unit, ensuring operational efficiency, productivity, quality, and compliance with established Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

This role will be responsible for coordinating warehouse activities across Receiving, Stocking, Shipping, Sorting, and Inventory, ensuring that operational processes are executed effectively and that teams are properly guided and supported to achieve business objectives.

The professional will also play an important role in monitoring operational performance, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement, solving operational issues, and implementing corrective actions to enhance overall warehouse performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Supervise daily logistics operations within the assigned business unit, ensuring activities are completed within established deadlines and quality standards.
  • Lead and engage employees in compliance with Occupational Health and Safety, Quality, and Environmental policies, as well as company standards and procedures.
  • Ensure the effective execution and maintenance of existing operational processes, while proactively identifying opportunities for improvement and greater efficiency.
  • Oversee key warehouse activities, including Receiving, Stocking, Shipping, Sorting, and Inventory, prioritizing and distributing tasks according to operational needs.
  • Provide guidance and support to the team, addressing operational challenges and resolving issues that may impact productivity, quality, or service levels.
  • Monitor operational progress and performance, identifying deviations and implementing corrective actions to ensure compliance with SLAs, productivity targets, and quality standards.
  • Track and analyze key operational performance indicators (KPIs), using data and logistics studies to identify trends, operational gaps, and opportunities to improve overall warehouse performance.
  • Coordinate physical inventory activities, ensuring proper execution and taking the necessary actions to maintain inventory accuracy.
  • Contribute to the implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of quality standards within the area of responsibility.
  • Provide regular feedback, guidance, and performance insights to leaders and coordinators, supporting team development and operational excellence.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure alignment between logistics operations and broader business requirements.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or above in Engineering, Business Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of professional experience in logistics or supply chain, preferably with experience in logistics operations, continuous improvement, distribution, supply chain, or demand planning.
  • Previous experience supervising or coordinating logistics or warehouse operations.
  • Strong problem-solving and data analysis skills, with the ability to interpret operational data and make sound, data-driven decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify operational inefficiencies and implement practical solutions to improve productivity, quality, and service levels.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with customers, peers, direct reports, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, managing multiple priorities while maintaining operational excellence.
  • Advanced English proficiency.
  • Availability to work shifts in Guarulhos.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in large-scale warehouse, fulfillment, distribution center, or e-commerce operations.
  • Experience with KPI management, operational performance analysis, inventory accuracy, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Experience working in high-volume and rapidly changing logistics environments.
